title: Hermes → DSH dispatch spec (dsh-hermes-link v0.5.0)
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 /tools/call dispatch_task arguments. Slim field surface; no audit-only fields at the protocol level (audit is server-side).

skill.description: Tool name to allow in the spawned sub-agent's toolFilter.

max_prompt_tokens.description: v0.5.0 (B1): hard cap on estimated prompt tokens. dispatch_task returns E_TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED (-32021) when over.

max_total_tokens.description: v0.5.0 (B1): hard cap on estimated prompt+output tokens. dispatch_task returns E_TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED (-32021) when over.

include_tokenizer_diagnostics.description: v0.5.0 (B1): if true, the dispatch_dry_run response includes result.tokenizer = { impl, status } so the Hermes-side caller can detect heuristic fallback.

mode.description: one-shot = full result in the dispatch reply; continuable = returns child_id, then Hermes drives followups via dispatch_followup / dispatch_interrupt.

provider.description: spawn: isolated child. fork: child inherits parent session history. Default: fork for continuable, spawn for one-shot.

shared_history_n.description: When provider=spawn, include this many recent parent turns as context. n=0 means none.

include_project_memory.description: v0.2.2: opt-in per-task inclusion of Hermes MEMORY.md entries that match the DSH session's cwd (state.db sessions where cwd == parent cwd). Off by default to avoid unrelated-project memory leaking into the sub-agent.
